request_source: meta_agent/tasks/002-echo-agent.md, opened by the design seat on plan.md 15-8; the plan and its milestones are the person's
paragraph: Build the first, harmless agent: one whose only tool is echo, a command that returns the text it is given together with the text's length, so that the Designer's whole path from intake to a handed-over bundle is exercised on a tool that cannot hurt anything. The agent must run its own regression and validation gates where it lands, without the Meta-Agent, and must refuse nothing it was not told to refuse and invent no number.
science_task: return the text it is given and report that text's character count

tool.name: echo
tool.language: any; the bundle carries a mock adapter in Python

must_not: invent a number or choose a tolerance
destination: chosen by the person at hand-over; the bundle stays under meta_agent/builds/ until then
priorities: the whole path runs end to end
nothing outside the bundle is touched
note: lab_profile_ref names the material-rich fixture lab, whose policy fields the fixture's answers confirmed; this lab's own profile (lab-kyu-softmatter) still waits for the person's answers and cannot be referenced by a goal (check 15).

tool_reading.claim: echo reads one JSON object from standard input and writes one JSON object to standard output
the exit status is zero whether echo answers or reports an error; the error is in the output
the input is an object with one required string field, message, which must not be empty
the output carries message, the same text, and length, the number of characters in message
a missing, non-string or empty message returns the error ECHO-INPUT-001 of category invalid_input, not retryable
length equals the character count of message, so it can be checked against an independent count of the same text
tool_reading.limitations: derived from the output table's wording; whether length counts code points or UTF-16 units is not stated

tool_reading.claim: echo has no state and no side effects

tool_reading.requires: a statement in the documentation, or a run in a sandbox with growing messages

tool_reading.claim: the real echo binary behaves as the mock adapter does
tool_reading.requires: analysis_permission from a person and a sandbox run of the real command

tool_contract.name: echo
tool_contract.description: return the given text and its character count; the mock adapter in this bundle stands in for the command

safety_gate.place: no side effects; src/gate.py is consulted by the runner and finds no gate required

error_contracts.message: message is missing, not a string, or empty

remediation.action: send a JSON object with a non-empty string field message

interface_tasks.name: a message comes back unchanged with its length
an empty message returns the documented error, not a crash
a missing message returns the documented error

scientific_tasks.name: length equals an independent character count of the same text

reference.ref: len(message): the character count of the input text, computed by the runner without the tool

scientific_tasks.note: the tolerance is a person's number; until one is chosen the verdict is undecided

replay_items.name: echo returns the text and its length
an empty message is refused with ECHO-INPUT-001
